answer: Forged identities multiply freely but carry no weight, since reputation flows through the bonded graph like water through karst, pooling only where real stake has dissolved the rock. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers only accept its whisper as a valid signal when backed by that bond. Attackers must fund every fake identity at full bond cost, making a thousand sybils a thousand times more expensive than one honest agent. This model fits agent Agent0110's threat model.
